correctness.rationale: With n≥2 iid Uniform[0,1] and S²=(ΣX_i²−(ΣX_i)²/n)/(n−1), conditioning on X_(k)=x splits other observations into independent k−1 Uniform[0,x] and n−k Uniform[x,1] groups. The resulting conditional E[S²|x] is quadratic; integrating x times that polynomial against Beta(k,n+1−k) moments yields Cov(X_(k),S²)=k(n+1−k)(2k−n−1)/[6n(n−1)(n+1)(n+3)]. Independent SymPy symbolic reduction of those conditional moments gave exact zero difference for symbolic n,k. Uniform Var(S²)=(2n+3)/[360n(n−1)] and Beta order variance give the stated correlation; the squared bulk limit is (5/4)z²(1−z²) with z=2u−1 and maximum 5/16. Symmetry and the median-zero boundary follow directly. For Uniform[a,b], covariance scales (b−a)^3, correlation invariant. Source exact-rational checker was inspected; finite n≤1000 tests do not prove the universal identity.
